<p class="project-page-intro">
Profiling workflows for finding bottlenecks across Python, PyTorch operators,
CUDA kernels, memory allocation, and full CPU/GPU timelines.
</p>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/torch-compile-internals" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">LLM Compiler Profiling</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Qwen2.5-0.5B FP32 on RTX 5050 with CUDA Graphs disabled: prefill kernels 1,385 → 482 for 44 tokens, decode kernels 8,968 → 3,280 for eight steps, and decode latency 97.9 → 66.8 ms. Traced fusion and attention changes; maximum logit error 6.1 × 10<sup>−5</sup>.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/cross_dsl_kernels" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

    <span class="project-row-meta">PyTorch and cuBLAS/cuBLASLt baselines, CUDA Graph replay, and 80/80 backend-shape correctness checks covering tails and KN/NK weight layouts. Profiling with PyTorch Profiler and Nsight Systems/Compute.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/triton-flash-attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

    <span class="project-row-meta">Nsight Systems/Compute profiling of FA2-style forward attention: 255 registers/thread and 8.3% occupancy at D=128, alongside correctness and SDPA performance comparisons.</span>
